rules.title: The script drops a table
rules.detail: A dropped table cannot be reviewed after the fact, and the backup that would restore it is only as good as the last restore test. In a review gate this is the one action that has to be approved by a person rather than by a rule.
rules.fix: Rename the table to <name>_deprecated, deploy, and drop it in a later release once nothing has read it. If the drop is intended, take it out of this script and run it as an approved change.

fires: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY); DROP TABLE IF EXISTS shop.orders_bak;
silent: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY);

rules.title: The script drops a column
rules.detail: A dropped column can be an application still reading it, a view that selects it, or a report nobody in this review has seen. Nothing in the script says who still reads it, and the failure appears in another team's code.
rules.fix: Rename the column to <name>_deprecated and deploy; drop it a release later, once the rename has shown nothing reads it. Remove this rule if your project drops columns behind a feature flag.

fires: ALTER TABLE shop.orders DROP COLUMN channel;
ALTER TABLE shop.orders DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS channel, ADD COLUMN channel_code TEXT;
silent: ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD COLUMN channel TEXT;
ALTER TABLE shop.orders ALTER COLUMN channel DROP NOT NULL;

rules.title: A column is added NOT NULL with no DEFAULT
rules.detail: The statement fails on any table that already has rows, and in a release it fails after the deploy has started, on the largest table in the batch. The schema it leaves behind looks correct, so the failure only lands in production.
rules.fix: Add a DEFAULT, or add the column nullable, backfill, then set NOT NULL in a later release.

fires: ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD COLUMN channel TEXT NOT NULL;
silent: ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD COLUMN channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web';
ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD COLUMN channel TEXT;
